metaDescription: Order custom neoprene lip balm in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Soft, durable sleeves protect your brand. Call for a quote today.
introHtml: Neoprene lip balm sleeves offer a soft, protective layer that keeps lip balm secure while providing a large, full-color printing area for your logo. Unlike standard plastic tubes, neoprene cases resist scratches and add a tactile, premium feel. Ideal for trade shows, corporate gifts, or safety kits, these custom neoprene lip balm holders combine practicality with brand visibility. Decorate with your logo or message using screen printing or heat transfer for a vibrant, durable finish.
